description: This file defines the ProductRelationshipService interface, specifying methods for managing product relationships, groups, and related retrieval operations in an e-commerce system.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves or updates a product relationship entity, potentially throwing a ServiceException.

methods.name: getByType
methods.description: Retrieves a list of product relationships matching specific store, product, and type, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: listByProduct
methods.description: Retrieves all relationships associated with a specific product.

methods.name: getGroups
methods.description: Returns a list of product relationship groups within a store.

methods.name: addGroup
methods.description: Creates a new product relationship group in a store.

methods.name: getByGroup
methods.description: Retrieves relationships belonging to a specific group within a store, optionally filtered by language.

methods.name: deleteGroup
methods.description: Deletes a specified group from a store.

methods.name: deactivateGroup
methods.description: Deactivates a group within a store, likely making it inactive.

methods.name: activateGroup
methods.description: Reactivates a previously deactivated group within a store.
